title: 1. Cancellations
body: Registration for 'Shreshta' events is generally non-cancellable. However, in case of a duplicate payment or technical error, please contact us immediately.

title: 2. Refunds
items: Refunds are only processed in cases of cancelled events or technical failures where money was deducted but the ticket was not generated.
Approved refunds will be processed within 5-7 working days.
The amount will be credited back to the original source of payment (Credit Card/UPI/Bank Account).

title: 3. Contact for Refunds
body: If you face any payment issues, please email us at shreshta@mgits.ac.in with your transaction ID.
